scope: Two explicitly authorized low-effort host workflows; functional delivery and targeted manual passage review, not a stable-release gate or paired benchmark.

host.isolation: Fresh private working/report directories; user config ignored; shell, plugins, apps, browser, computer use and multi-agent features disabled; only Sibyl MCP preapproved; cancel hidden. Existing CLI auth, no credential files copied or inspected.
host.usage_scope: CLI-reported cumulative per-turn token usage, including repeated cached context; two workflows are not a claim of only two low-level inference calls or exact monetary/subscription cost.

prompts.unknown: Use Sibyl to investigate the exact realized global market share NVIDIA will have in AI accelerators in 2030. Distinguish forecasts from observed outcomes. I want a short answer without invented numbers, plus Markdown and JSON reports saved through Sibyl. At most two retrieval calls; use only Sibyl tools, with no shell commands or local source inspection. Finish within 100 seconds and preserve any uncertainty in the reports.
prompts.recommendation: Use Sibyl to research whether SQLite WAL is suitable for a local application with several reader processes and two occasional writers on one machine. I value simplicity, but I cannot afford silently lost writes. Investigate a limitation or counterargument before recommending anything. Do not invent performance measurements for my workload. Save a concise Markdown report and a JSON report through Sibyl, and tell me the outcome and paths. Keep the investigation to at most three retrieval calls. Use only Sibyl tools; do not read local source files, run shell commands, or modify code. Finish within 100 seconds, preserving gaps honestly if necessary.

tool_errors.message: A supported inference or recommendation cannot depend on unresolved or disputed claims.

observations: Final answer and report keep the realized 2030 share unknown; attributed numerical forecasts are distinguished from observed outcomes.
The two attributed numerical statements were checked against their cited retained excerpts; no primary forecast methodology was obtained.
A supported inference depending on an unresolved premise was rejected. The host repaired its assessment using the returned current revision and then exported actual md/json artifacts.
Only one retrieval was used; counterevidence/question coverage remains incomplete and the report stays partial.

manual_review.outcome: Delivery success, but semantic support is insufficient for the requested recommendation.

unsupported_qualification.claim_text: WAL permits reading and writing concurrently, but only one writer can write at a time.
unsupported_qualification.finding: The cited excerpt supports reader/writer overlap, not the only-one-writer qualification. The fact was not determined false; its recorded support is incomplete.
unsupported_qualification.model_free_followup: Re-reading the same official source produced the identical 30000-character source hash. The writer-limit phrase begins at character 7390, outside all selected excerpts for this broad query.

observations: The initial focused site query returned no sources; a second host-authored counterevidence query discovered the official WAL page without human URL rescue.
The network-filesystem and synchronous=NORMAL/checkpoint passages support their respective recorded qualifications.
User durability/simplicity criteria and uncertainty about the exact workload remain explicit; no workload performance measurements were invented.
The unreviewed first question and other gaps remain in the partial report; export success is not research completeness.

conclusion: Both workflows delivered confirmed Markdown and JSON reports within the authorized timeout. This is not a 2/2 research-quality pass: the SQLite recommendation contains a material qualification without supporting cited passage text. The earlier failed full live gate remains open. The approved two-workflow allowance is exhausted; no further model request is authorized by this record.
limitations: One host/model and two purposively selected tasks; no blinded scoring, cross-host compatibility result, native-search comparator or causal improvement estimate.
Raw traces, checkpoints and third-party page excerpts are retained privately under /tmp/sibyl-host-retest-20261026, not committed.
